Evelyn Park: OrbitWave case study ready for final pass. Uploaded transcript + extracts. Target publish Thu 07/14 09:00 PT (embargo). Need legal sign-off + customer preview.
Diego Marin: I'll handle customer quote approval. Draft hero quote: "Redwood reduced inference latency and let us ship our recommendation feature faster." Sending to OrbitWave now.
Hannah Cho: Creative ETA: 48h after final assets. Will produce hero image, 3 social cards, 2 promo clips (15s/45s), and a one-pager PDF.
LegalBot: Please attach the benchmark methodology doc and signed release. We require phrasing like "approximately X% improvement" and citation to test ID OW-2026-09. Redact any internal emails in the transcript.
Diego Marin: Customer responded: approve with tweak. New phrasing requested: "Redwood reduced our median latency by ~35%, helping us ship recommendations sooner." They signed the release and uploaded it to the shared drive.
Evelyn Park: Thanks. Ops note: tag incoming leads from the landing form with "orbitwave-case" and route to AE queue; create a gated one-pager for lead quality.
OpsBot: HubSpot form created and routing configured to AE and CS queues with tag orbitwave-case. UTM parameters set for campaign.
Hannah Cho: Legal redactions applied and assets exported. Uploading final hero + clips now. ETA for uploads: end of day tomorrow.
LegalBot: Release verified: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/orbitwave/RELEASE_1793123520.pdf. Legal approves copy and benchmark blurb once landing page cites OW-2026-09.
Evelyn Park: Great work team. Diego will post landing draft for OrbitWave preview by Tue 07/12. We will publish after customer preview and embargo. :rocket:
